name: Wall Downward Dog
focus: Shoulders and back of the legs
description: Downward Dog standing at a wall: hands on the wall, hinge at your hips until your back is flat and your arms and legs make an L.
setup: Stand an arm's length or more from a wall, feet hip-width apart.
Put your hands on the wall at shoulder height.
cues: Soften your knees if your hamstrings pull.

keyframes.name: Hands on the wall
keyframes.cue: Hands at shoulder height, arms straight.

keyframes.name: Wall Downward Dog
keyframes.cue: Walk back and hinge until your back is flat.

prescription.note: Breathe slowly and evenly; ease out of the pose if anything pinches.
